About Casablanca

The Casablanca bed designed by Paola Navone for Baxter stands out for the refined simplicity of its forms. An informal, relaxed design made irresistibly inviting by its soft padding and leather upholstery. Spacious and elegant, the upholstered bed consists of a frame topped by a generous headboard which folds down to form two large pillows that invite you to snuggle down and sleep, read or just simply relax. An all-round celebration of our need to enjoy a well-deserved rest, a bedroom accessory of timeless elegance that lends style and originality to any home.
